The *Saḷalapupphikātherīapadāna* (Thi Ap 12) is a verse narrative text belonging to the *Therīapadāna* section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records five translations of the work across five different modern languages [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels are attested in the DharmaNexus database [DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis records extensive Pali-internal text reuse, with 93 matching passages identified across 39 distinct Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest alignments appear in the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (matching segments §0.3–5.4 with §585–594 at 0.93 similarity) and with the counterpart male biographical verse in the *Therāpadāna*, the *Saḷalapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 372, segments §0.3–5.3) [DharmaNexus]. The narrative's concluding sections (§§5.1–10.1) share extensive formulaic verse units with multiple other *Therīapadāna* texts, including the *Naḷamālikātherīapadāna* (Thi Ap 16 and Thi Ap 5), the *Ekūposathikātherīapadāna* (Thi Ap 11), and the *Sattuppalamālikātherīapadāna* (Thi Ap 8) [DharmaNexus].
